description: This header file declares internal functions for the CCSP Namespace Manager component, including functions for namespace registration, unregistration, discovery, and management, used within the CCSP platform. It contains function prototypes and macro guards, with no implementation details.

methods.name: CcspNsMgrGetCountOfRegNamespace
methods.description: Retrieves the count of registered namespaces managed by the object.

methods.name: CcspNsMgrLookforComponent
methods.description: Searches for a component by name within the namespace manager.

methods.name: CcspNsMgrRegisterNamespaces
methods.description: Registers multiple namespaces for a specified component.

methods.name: CcspNsMgrBuildNamespaces
methods.description: Builds namespace entries for a component, likely preparing internal structures.

methods.name: CcspNsMgrUnregisterNamespace
methods.description: Unregisters a specific namespace for a component.

methods.name: CcspNsMgrUnregisterComponent
methods.description: Unregisters an entire component and all associated namespaces.

methods.name: CcspNsMgrDiscoverNamespace
methods.description: Discovers namespaces, optionally at the next hierarchy level, returning components and namespace data.

methods.name: CcspNsMgrCheckNamespaceDataType
methods.description: Checks if a namespace's data type matches the expected type.

methods.name: CcspNsMgrGetRegisteredComponents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all registered components.

methods.name: CcspNsMgrGetNamespaceByComponent
methods.description: Gets all namespaces associated with a specified component.

methods.name: CcspNsMgrCleanAll
methods.description: Cleans up all namespace manager data structures.

methods.name: CcspNsMgrDumpObject
methods.description: Outputs the state of the namespace manager object, likely for debugging.
